297:     for (int shift = 1; ; ++shift) {
298:       final long delta = (b >>> shift) - (a >>> shift);
299:       if (delta >= 0 && delta < Grid.ARITY) {

416:       }

34:  * @lucene.experimental

36: public final class GeoEncodingUtils {
37:   /** number of bits used for quantizing latitude and longitude values */
38:   public static final short BITS = 32;
39: 
40:   private static final double LAT_SCALE = (0x1L << BITS) / 180.0D;
41:   private static final double LAT_DECODE = 1 / LAT_SCALE;
42:   private static final double LON_SCALE = (0x1L << BITS) / 360.0D;
43:   private static final double LON_DECODE = 1 / LON_SCALE;
44: 
45:   public static final int MIN_LON_ENCODED = encodeLongitude(MIN_LON_INCL);
46:   public static final int MAX_LON_ENCODED = encodeLongitude(MAX_LON_INCL);
47: 
48:   // No instance:
49:   private GeoEncodingUtils() {}
50: 
51:   /**
52:    * Quantizes double (64 bit) latitude into 32 bits (rounding down: in the direction of -90)
53:    *
54:    * @param latitude latitude value: must be within standard +/-90 coordinate bounds.
55:    * @return encoded value as a 32-bit {@code int}
56:    * @throws IllegalArgumentException if latitude is out of bounds
57:    */
58:   public static int encodeLatitude(double latitude) {
59:     checkLatitude(latitude);
60:     // the maximum possible value cannot be encoded without overflow
61:     if (latitude == 90.0D) {
62:       latitude = Math.nextDown(latitude);
63:     }
64:     return (int) Math.floor(latitude / LAT_DECODE);
65:   }
66: 
67:   /**
68:    * Quantizes double (64 bit) latitude into 32 bits (rounding up: in the direction of +90)
69:    *
70:    * @param latitude latitude value: must be within standard +/-90 coordinate bounds.
71:    * @return encoded value as a 32-bit {@code int}
72:    * @throws IllegalArgumentException if latitude is out of bounds
73:    */
74:   public static int encodeLatitudeCeil(double latitude) {
75:     GeoUtils.checkLatitude(latitude);
76:     // the maximum possible value cannot be encoded without overflow
77:     if (latitude == 90.0D) {
78:       latitude = Math.nextDown(latitude);
79:     }
80:     return (int) Math.ceil(latitude / LAT_DECODE);
81:   }

83:   /**
84:    * Quantizes double (64 bit) longitude into 32 bits (rounding down: in the direction of -180)
85:    *
86:    * @param longitude longitude value: must be within standard +/-180 coordinate bounds.
87:    * @return encoded value as a 32-bit {@code int}
88:    * @throws IllegalArgumentException if longitude is out of bounds
89:    */

91:     checkLongitude(longitude);
92:     // the maximum possible value cannot be encoded without overflow
93:     if (longitude == 180.0D) {

95:     }

97:   }

part.text:
Fixed the north-pole narrow-polygon failure in `lucene/core/src/java/org/apache/lucene/geo/GeoEncodingUtils.java`.

The grid predicate’s `latBase + maxLatDelta` upper-bound check could overflow at the maximum encoded latitude, incorrectly rejecting matching points. It now uses a subtraction-based `latOffset` bounds check, avoiding overflow in both component and distance predicates.

Validation passed:

```text
./gradlew --no-daemon :lucene:core:test --tests org.apache.lucene.search.TestLatLonDocValuesQueries.testNarrowPolygonCloseToNorthPole
```
